description: SBPA supplier invoice approval workflow with variance-based routing. Contains ScriptTasks for variance calculation, a UserTask (SAP Task Center node) for manual approval, and a RuleTask (Business Rules decision) that is not converted. The main workflow is triggered by an S/4HANA business event (supplierInvoiceCreated) rather than a plain webhook, and the UserTask requires manual interaction to proceed — full end-to-end execution is not testable in the eval harness. Validated at report level only.
